list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Add support for thesis graphs, forecasts, and hypotheses in frame serialization logic
- Updated `frame` logic in the `Thesis` struct to include `Graphs`, `Forecasts`, `Hypotheses`, and `Categories` for enhanced data representation. - Improved test coverage in `thesis_test.go` to validate new serialization fields. - Enhanced `JournalSurface` in the frontend to utilize `tradeJournalValues` and `findingsList` for better state extraction. - Introduced `CircularBuffer` in collections for bounded buffer management, improving memory efficiency. - Refactored lifecycle and findings stores to integrate circular buffers for retaining snapshots. - Improved `Audit trail` in `dashboard-rail` to filter and format trade observations for clarity. - Added benchmark and unit tests in broker position logic to validate ticker acknowledgment. - Extended Thesis types with new data structures for forecasts, hypotheses, and categories to support detailed analytics.
